main_body: desert building with flat roof, turquoise dome, and sandstone brick front wall
top_band: light sandy tan flat roof terrace with parapet and turquoise dome (rows 2 to 33)
evidence: Rows 2-33 show the top surface of the flat roof bounded by a raised parapet (with inner drop shadow at row 4 and left column) and a dome sitting on top of the terrace. Row 32-33 is a lighter front-edge cornice, followed by rows 34-36 eave shadow over the vertical brick wall (rows 34-65) which has an inset arched doorway and window.

style.evidence: The building uses 5-6 shading steps on the dome, roof, and brick wall, with dark brown/teal material outlines rather than black. The roof has varied sandy speckle, the dome has tiled shading, and the wall has textured bricks with mortar shadows and an inset arched door and latticed window.
